'''Siltcrawlers''' were creatures from the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nelvaan/Legends|Nelvaan]]. They dug burrows for homes, were capable of hibernation, and lived in colonies. The massive and carnivorous [[Horax/Legends|horaxes]] often split open these burrows with their snout horns in order to eat entire colonies whole.<ref name="DB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Siltcrawlers were mentioned in the [[Databank (original)|original Databank]] entry "Horax" on [[StarWars.com]].<ref name="DB" />
